# M78 local operator plan

Task M78-OPERATORS-01; security/reliability implementation by `/root/m78_security`, sponsored by root/CTO. Requested registry Astra/high; actual reused executor settings unknown. No independent review or native execution is claimed by this initial plan. Root owns hosted execution, credentials, journals, integration and publication.

## Scope and sequencing

Prepare local schema20-to21 backup, restore, upgrade and replay helpers. Migration21 is currently a draft: no execution or final migration digest until its sole author freezes it. Read existing M77 helpers without changing them. Preserve M77 journals, source contracts and reports. All writes in a rehearsal go only into a newly created `m78_ops_*` or `m78_qa_*` loopback database on the explicitly admitted local PostgreSQL port. Never reset an existing database, change global roles or decrypt private configuration. An unavailable/mismatched cluster role is a prerequisite failure, not permission to create/grant it.

1. Freeze reviewed migration21 and the first20 exact receipt manifest; root supplies a read-only schema20 source or already prepared synthetic application bundle. Fresh clone name and source identity are explicit inputs. Root's actual hosted baseline remains separate evidence.
2. Capture one repeatable-read, read-only application snapshot and exported pg_dump snapshot. Reuse M77 row/catalog/sequence inventory and schema20 content manifest. Recheck non-MVCC sequence state; reject activity during capture. Auth dependency UUID stubs and exact auth.uid definition are included; provider accounts/sessions/storage/configuration and role passwords are excluded. This local helper does not claim encrypted hosted backup.
3. Restore that bundle once into a fresh clone. Compare every original row/hash/multiplicity, catalog/ACL/owner, role flag/membership/default ACL, sequence, exact statements/exports/reports and dependency content. Confirm runtime no-claim denial and a preexisting authorized synthetic actor read. Never touch an occupied target.
4. Upgrade the clone inside one transaction under the existing staging advisory and table locks. Check exact schema20 receipts, project marker, full baseline and runtime/legacy containment first. Apply only reviewed21 and insert exactly one21 receipt. Compare original rows/counts (only receipt append permitted), sequences, all original catalog objects and roles. Admit exactly eight initially empty scope1 tables and their reviewed objects; admit only the six reviewed existing function search_path changes. Any unexpected mutation rolls back.
5. Populate a small new-company synthetic fixture through the backend author's existing M78 fixture helper and public application writers. Cover both families, separate eligible reviews, a report before review, a report after review, and one later correction so historic proof/null-review behavior is occupied. Include all four compatible source families using the accepted accounting fixture; do not rebuild long M77 hosted history for each test.
6. Capture the populated21 bundle; restore once into a second new clone. Replay M78 retained versions, decisions, statement bytes, proof and HTML/snapshot reports through actual runtime methods/routes and frontend decoder; compare the source and restored content inventory. Old source/report journal bytes remain exact. One bounded legacy compatibility sample per retained family plus the complete legacy byte manifest demonstrates the targeted recovery boundary; this is not a fresh full-history semantic replay claim. A full legacy sweep is needed only once if changed integrations create a concrete compatibility concern.

## Small reusable implementation

| Owned path | Responsibility and reuse |
| --- | --- |
| `tools/staging/m78-inventory.ts` | Reuse M77 inventory, validators, runtime guard and schema20 recovery manifest. Add21 content entries and exact six-function catalog normalization; pin receipts without calling M77's now20-only manifest guard. |
| `tools/staging/m78-backup.ts` | Exported snapshot application bundle for20/21; caller supplies admitted local connection/pg_dump. No credential loading, cloud transport or import-time work. |
| `tools/staging/m78-upgrade.ts` | Pure gate validation plus transaction-scoped reviewed21 application and durable exclusive outcome journal. No automatic invocation by startup. |
| `tools/staging/m78-restore.ts` | Restore trusted synthetic bundle to a new local database, prerequisite role verification, exact post-restore comparisons. Failed clones stay retained for diagnosis. |
| `tools/staging/m78-replay.ts` | Bounded occupied M78 runtime/proof/report replay with exact coverage counters and explicit legacy-byte versus semantic-replay distinction. |
| `tools/staging/m78-operators.test.ts` and optional native companion | Meaningful corruption/drift/target/receipt refusal tests; one opt-in native upgrade and populated restore lifecycle after freeze. |

No duplicated all-history M77 framework, global fetch replacement, secret-bearing logs, or altered migration20. Reuse the backend fixture module read-only and coordinate its supported population API with its author. Generated synthetic receipts stay in a new local output directory, with receipt/hash paths in the final evidence map.

## Exact invariant boundaries

The expected added tables are `scope1_audit`, `scope1_heads`, `scope1_process_discoveries`, `scope1_reports`, `scope1_requests`, `scope1_reviews`, `scope1_statements`, `scope1_versions`. Final names require frozen migration verification. Runtime has no direct DML and every new table has ENABLE/FORCE RLS; endpoints anon/authenticated remain denied. Runtime narrowly named writer execution and internal helper denial must be checked from actual grants, not merely function names.

The only admitted changes to existing functions are `search_path=pg_catalog, pg_temp` on `neuvetra.electricity_source_fixtures()`, `reject_inventory_history_mutation()`, `m67_method()`, `m67_limitations()`, `m68_limitations()`, and `annual_evidence_report_template()`. Compare function bodies, owner, language, arguments/results, volatility, security mode, null/parallel/leakproof properties and effective ACLs unchanged; all other existing function catalog rows remain exact. `pg_get_functiondef` includes SET clauses, so a whole-definition hash cannot be naively exempted: compare full properties/body and remove only the admitted SET difference. Literal fixture/method/template outputs and history-trigger42501 refusal remain targeted native checks.

Content21 retains version activity/dependencies/statements/findings/reconciliation/proof, separate decisions, exact statement UTF-8 bytes, reports' HTML/snapshot bytes and hashes, and complete heads/request/audit/discovery records. Validate lengths and hashes together; duplicate composite identities fail. Equal coordinated corruption is challenged by semantic decoder/authority replay. Unknown/incomplete totals remain unknown; operator tools do not approve methods or invent coverage.

## Failure and retry discipline

Before a consequential local migration, reserve an exclusive journal and flush a started record. Record reviewed migration, baseline/bundle hashes, clone identity and independent gate receipt. A transaction error is not a successful receipt. If COMMIT was attempted but acknowledgment or receipt persistence fails, label outcome unknown and inspect exact receipts/current inventory before any retry. If committed but receipt failed, never reapply. Existing receipts/targets refuse, rather than overwrite. No down migration, receipt deletion, history removal, or schema20-only image readiness claim against21. Root chooses a reviewed21-compatible recovery image or separately authorized pre-upgrade restoration.

Gate validation binds operator/reviewer distinct identities, exact migration and code review snapshot, baseline backup/restore hashes, populated21 forward-recovery proof and timestamps; a JSON attestation is not a cryptographic identity service. Local author rehearsal does not create hosted authority. Root's later hosted gate must refresh maintenance, deployment/checks and backup evidence and explicitly own the execution.

## Acceptance evidence still required

- Frozen21 and exact20 manifest, catalog/row/content delta and immutable source pins.
- Unit refusals for changed/duplicate/missing receipts, table/row/catalog/ACL/role/sequence drift, six-function body/flag changes disguised as path fixes, corrupt dump/content, occupied/foreign targets, stale/mismatched gates and uncertain retries.
- Opt-in native clone20 upgrade, forced rollback, populated21 restore, runtime no-claim/member boundary, exact M78 proof/report replay and unchanged original source/journal/report content. Independent QA reviews exact candidate and evidence.

Applicable lessons: L02 (coordinated persisted-byte corruption and exact review pins) and L05 (preserve failure/authority and do not bypass frozen provenance). Native driver lifecycle proof also supports the existing L07 boundary, without duplicating the domain oracle.

## Initial implementation evidence

The six owned TypeScript files now provide a local bundle/restore entry, exclusive append-only started/outcome journals, migration/role/ACL/row/content guards and bounded actual M78 route/browser-decoder replay. `REVIEWED_MIGRATION_SHA256` is deliberately null while21 is a draft, so no upgrade or21 restore can execute. No database connection, private file or hosted action has been used for this assignment.

First pure check: five tests passed and one failed because an inherited letters-only identifier rule rejects `scope1_*`. This author failure is retained here. M77 inventory and its validators share the same restriction, so direct reuse for21 was unsafe. The small M78 catalog/row reader now permits validated SQL identifiers with digits, preserves the earlier catalog/row algorithms, and reuses M73's comparison primitives plus M77's full schema20 content manifest, runtime guards and byte-entry logic. Original helpers remain untouched. The corrected initial suite passed6tests/33assertions; a strict targeted TypeScript check also passed. Additional local gate/row regression cases are included in the current candidate. This is code/pure-check evidence only, not native recovery proof.

Implementation scope is local-only: gate receipts are local author/independent-review attestations, not hosted permits. Bundle storage remains in memory for this helper, with no encrypted-backup claim. Root's later encrypted hosted capture/admission must be separately integrated and reviewed. The new replay takes an explicit occupied fixture company (maximum12versions/12reports), exercises every M78 version/report in it, and preserves a full legacy byte inventory while explicitly reporting `legacyFullSemanticReplay:false`; it does not silently claim old all-history runtime replay.

### First rehearsal admission and hold

Independent reviewer `/root/m76_backend` accepted the six-file null-pin candidate for a first local rehearsal only, contingent on final pin rereview; its immutable candidate1 snapshot is `M78-OPERATOR-LOCAL-REVIEW-01-CANDIDATE1.json`, SHA `d29ed11ded659908721c7271c7320fe3759fb988f0302fde1bfc0d956b8514b9`. The reviewer disclosed historical authorship of unchanged M77 operators and does not reapprove those algorithms. Combined author/reviewer pure controls passed13tests/78assertions. This does not admit a later changed candidate or hosted work.

Root then supplied backend candidate21 SHA `592821990b0016671a33d7ebc900799245993f59a970c8c06c577d1639d36016` and an immutable populated source/receipt. Before any operator database connection, root held execution after independent backend INT-F01 exposed a valid-blocked inventory finding-origin mismatch. The executable pin was returned to null. No native backup, restore or upgrade occurred. The old source and receipt remain historical; a repaired migration requires a matching newly prepared source/receipt, not an edited old receipt.

The added `m78-operators-native.ts` harness is prepared for targeted rereview: explicit flag, fresh independent seven-file admission, exact source receipt/SQL pins, one schema20 restore with stale/occupied/rollback/reapply controls, one populated21 restore/replay, exact source inventories before/after, and durable failure artifacts. It takes the preserved populated fixture instead of repeating38 application writes. Source allowlists are exact; target databases are fresh M78 operator names only. The first local rehearsal admission intentionally does not demand completed populated21 recovery before that rehearsal exists. The populated-forward proof remains a later release/admission prerequisite.

Repaired author freeze: migration21 `b62c9645448848c57b358a9741168c0556bbcd6d205f9236b51ca47c147bca6a`, populated source `m78_author_native_1789618445805`, receipt `.superpowers/m78_author_native_1789618445805-result.json` SHA `3c8ba44a387fabf4a6294b04aa204359251ce836a3bac3f95d9673231db6f915`. The seven-file operator candidate pins this repaired source. Native execution still waits independent targeted admission. Previous5928 remains historical, never relabeled.

Root additionally assigned authorship of `check-m78-hosted.ts` and its pure tests. These are separate from the seven-file local admission: fixed Neuvetra/Auth endpoints, schema21, exact accepted M77 continuation, durable POST intent/outcome verification, exclusive journal, baseline/exercise/revisit, full retained legacy bytes, M78 decoders/downloads and role refusals. Root's `exerciseM78` recipe remains read-only. Author does not contact the host, load credentials or execute the harness. Independent/root source review and later fresh live admission are mandatory. Existing M72 read-only legacy verification may be reused with an explicitly checked actual21 readiness adapter; no original journal is replayed and no legacy writes are allowed.

### First native failure and candidate3 repair

The admitted candidate2 native run stopped at read_only_sources with PostgreSQL42725 before any CREATE/restore/migration. Exact failure evidence: `.superpowers/m78-operators-1789619198470/failure.json`. A read-only diagnostic identified ambiguous text concatenation with the internal char trigger-enabled field. Candidate3 changes only that SQL expression to `t.tgenabled::text`; a repeat read-only inventory succeeded with113tables/2210table objects. Original source and global roles were never written. A new exact-source admission is required before a fresh native attempt. Current combined author local/hosted pure checks:13tests96assertions pass.

The hosted harness first pure auth test failed before login because its16MB parser bound exceeded the inherited10MB maximum. The limit was corrected to10MB; all5hosted pure tests45assertions pass, including cleanup of known sessions after subject mismatch and pre-network refusal of an uncertain prior journal. This is mocked transport evidence only.

function gate():LocalUpgradeGate{const inventory:Inventory={tables:[{name:'schema_migrations',count:20,sha256:digest,rowHashes:Array(20).fill(digest)},...Array.from({length:112},(_,i)=>({name:'original_'+i,count:0,sha256:hash([]),rowHashes:[]}))],metadata:{functions:hash([])},catalogRowHashes:{functions:[]},functions:[],tableObjects:[],sequences:[],roles:[],memberships:[],defaultAcls:[],dependencies:[]};return {profile:'neuvetra.m78.local-upgrade-gate.v1',project:'icockcoguyadhryzydvl',database:'m78_qa_independent',createdAt:'2026-09-17T00:00:00.000Z',operatorId:'/root/m78_security',reviewerId:'/root/m76_backend',reviewSnapshotSha256:digest,migrationSha256:digest,baselineBundleSha256:digest,restoreReceiptSha256:digest,baselineInventory:inventory,baselineContent:{profile:'neuvetra.m78.recovery-content.v1',schemaVersion:20,entries:[],sha256:hash([])},localOnly:true}}
test('independent local source target checks refuse remote, runtime, hosted and wrong port',async()=>{const good={name:'m78_qa_independent',address:'127.0.0.1',port:55472,actor:'supabase_admin'},sql=(row:unknown)=>({query:async()=>({rows:[row]})}as any);expect((await localSource(sql(good))).name).toBe(good.name);for(const change of [{address:'192.0.2.1'},{port:5432},{port:55463},{actor:'neuvetra_runtime'},{name:'postgres'},{name:'m78_author_fixture'},{name:'m78_qa_x;drop'}])await expect(localSource(sql({...good,...change}))).rejects.toThrow()})
test('independent frozen pin admits exact gate and refuses null, identity, receipt and time drift',()=>{expect(REVIEWED_MIGRATION_SHA256).toBe('b62c9645448848c57b358a9741168c0556bbcd6d205f9236b51ca47c147bca6a');const g=gate(),now=Date.parse('2026-09-17T00:01:00Z');expect(()=>validateLocalGate(g,digest,now)).not.toThrow();expect(()=>validateLocalGate({...g,migrationSha256:REVIEWED_MIGRATION_SHA256!},undefined,now)).not.toThrow();expect(()=>validateLocalGate(g,null,now)).toThrow();for(const change of [{reviewerId:g.operatorId},{reviewerId:' reviewer '},{operatorId:'operator\n'},{reviewSnapshotSha256:'not-a-snapshot-hash'},{baselineBundleSha256:'b'.repeat(63)},{restoreReceiptSha256:null},{migrationSha256:'b'.repeat(64)},{createdAt:'2026-09-17T00:01:00.001Z'}])expect(()=>validateLocalGate({...g,...change}as any,digest,now)).toThrow()})
test('schema21 receipt check refuses explicitly absent pin before supplied SQL connection',async()=>{let reads=0;await expect(canonicalReceipts({query:async()=>{reads++;throw Error('SQL should not be called')}}as any,21,null)).rejects.toThrow();expect(reads).toBe(0)})
test('all six exact function changes keep bodies and ACLs; additional SET or security flags refuse',()=>{const before:FunctionRow[]=PATH_FUNCTIONS.map(signature=>({signature,owner:'postgres',prosecdef:false,proconfig:null,acl:[{grantee:'postgres',privilege:'EXECUTE'}],definition:`CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ${signature}\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\nAS $function$SELECT 'π'$function$\n`})),line=" SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'\n",after=before.map(f=>({...f,proconfig:['search_path=pg_catalog, pg_temp'],definition:f.definition.replace('AS $function$',line+'AS $function$')}));expect(()=>sameFunctionsAfterUpgrade(before,after)).not.toThrow();for(const mutate of [(v:FunctionRow[])=>v[0].definition=v[0].definition.replace('AS $function$',line+'AS $function$'),(v:FunctionRow[])=>v[0].definition=v[0].definition.replace('π','replacement'),(v:FunctionRow[])=>v[0].prosecdef=true,(v:FunctionRow[])=>v[0].acl=[{grantee:'PUBLIC',privilege:'EXECUTE'}]]){const bad=structuredClone(after);mutate(bad);expect(()=>sameFunctionsAfterUpgrade(before,bad)).toThrow()}})
test('untrusted restore bundle refuses without database connection or target creation',()=>{const raw={profile:'neuvetra.m78.local-application-bundle.v1',project:'foreign',schemaVersion:20,migrationSha256:null};expect(()=>validateBundle(raw as any,hash(raw))).toThrow()})
test('exact seven-source rehearsal admission refuses reviewer, pin, stale time, duplicates and missing sources before native work',async()=>{const paths=['inventory','backup','upgrade','restore','replay','operators.test','operators-native'].map(n=>'tools/staging/m78-'+n+'.ts'),g:RehearsalAdmission={profile:'neuvetra.m78.local-rehearsal-admission.v1',createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),reviewerId:'/root/m76_backend',reviewSnapshotSha256:digest,migrationSha256:REVIEWED_MIGRATION_SHA256!,reviewedArtifacts:await Promise.all(paths.map(async path=>({path,sha256:createHash('sha256').update(await readFile(path)).digest('hex')}))),localOnly:true};await expect(verifyRehearsalAdmission(g)).resolves.toBeUndefined();for(const change of [{reviewerId:'/root/m78_security'},{migrationSha256:digest},{localOnly:false},{createdAt:new Date(Date.now()-14400001).toISOString()},{reviewedArtifacts:g.reviewedArtifacts.slice(1)},{reviewedArtifacts:[g.reviewedArtifacts[0],...g.reviewedArtifacts.slice(0,-1)]},{reviewedArtifacts:g.reviewedArtifacts.map((a,i)=>i===6?{...a,sha256:digest}:a)}])await expect(verifyRehearsalAdmission({...g,...change}as any)).rejects.toThrow()})
